01OUR COMPANY

Built on Experience.
Driven by Innovation.

Professional Architectural & Smart Lighting Solutions Provider

Zhejiang Jindalai Lighting Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based lighting technology company specializing in architectural lighting, commercial lighting, hospitality lighting and intelligent lighting solutions.

Backed by a team with over 20 years of industry experience, we integrate research and development, lighting design, product supply and technical support to serve professional lighting projects and international B2B partners.

01 / Architectural floodlighting

Chengyun Technology — City Cloud & Big Data Industrial Base

Binjiang District, Hangzhou, China
Construction started: March 2023

A technology campus in the Binjiang Internet Economy Industrial Park, with a brief for a modern, precise architectural lighting identity.

More than 3,000 custom lighting units, including flexible LED strips, linear lights and floodlights.

02 / Residential & landscape lighting

Yueqing H-b12 & H-b15-1 Nightscape Lighting

Yueqing, Zhejiang, China
Completed: March 2020

Nightscape lighting for urban plots surrounded by residential communities, riverside landscape and sports facilities.

More than 10,000 custom lighting units, including flexible LED strips, linear lights and floodlights.

03 / Architectural facade lighting

Qijia Ship Lock — Facade Enhancement Lighting

Qijia River, Hangzhou, China
Completed: 2022

A lighting approach responding to flowing water and the changing form of a twisted ribbon facade at the Xiaoshan–Binjiang boundary.

More than 3,000 custom lighting units, including linear lights.
